events.action: D1 and D2 were arrested in a night raid on their rented room on 7 February 2020 and have been detained since.
Charges of illegal possession of firearms and explosives were filed, based on weapons police say they found in the room.
About a year after the arrest, terrorism-financing charges were added, based on former insurgents' accounts and funds from the room.
The prosecution relies on a 2017 designation of the CPP-NPA; the Anti-Terrorism Council's own designation is dated 9 December 2020.
A warrant affidavit says surveillance began in October 2019, based on an unidentified informant.
The day before the raid, a letter asked the Commission on Human Rights to inspect an office and certify it held no illegal items; receipt was confirmed and no inspection took place.
